style: Hand-painted 2D mobile strategy-game art in the style of Forge of Empires and Clash Royale: rich warm colours, crimson and gold palette, soft painterly shading with crisp readable silhouettes, gentle rim light, slightly exaggerated friendly proportions (large heads, expressive faces), clean dark outlines. Biblical ancient Near East setting. Polished, premium, family-friendly. If a style reference screenshot is attached, match its palette and mood (red throne room, parchment, gold).
